params.name: vpAreaName
params.description: 4D View Pro area form object name

params.name: formulaObj
params.description: Object whose properties define the 4D formulas that can be called from 4D View Pro formulas

overloads.semanticRole: The VP SET CUSTOM FUNCTIONS command designates the 4D formulas that can be called directly from 4D View Pro formulas.

constraints: Because custom functions are not stored in the document, this command must be executed in the On Load form event.
If called multiple times for the same area in the same session, only the last call is taken into account.
As soon as VP SET CUSTOM FUNCTIONS is called, any methods allowed via VP SET ALLOWED METHODS are ignored in that 4D View Pro area.
As soon as VP SET CUSTOM FUNCTIONS is called, functions based on SET TABLE TITLES and SET FIELD TITLES are ignored in that 4D View Pro area.
formulaObj.<customFunction>.parameters[].type is optional (or -1) except when at least one parameter is of collection type, in which case it is mandatory for that function.

When a parameter's type is omitted or -1, its value is sent with its native type, except Date/Time values which are sent as an object; when type is 'Is object', the object is sent in a .value property.
formulaObj.<customFunction>.maxParams may be set higher than the length of the parameters collection to declare optional parameters with a default type.
